main_text.p: Conclusio : Verum jejunium Christianorum non consistere in delectu ciborum, neque esse paucorum dierum abstinentiam: sed esse perpe-tuam vitæ sobrietatem ac temperantiam.
main_text.head: Exercitatio VIII.

head.i: Censura affinitatis & expeditionis Iosaphati cum impio Achabo.2.Chron.18.&19.

main_text.p: Hypothesis de Iosaphati fortuna, affinitate & expeditione contra Syros cum impio Achabo.
Ratio 1. Quia affinitas & societas militaris cũ impiis sit quædam conspiratio in Deum.
Probetur ex verbis Prophetæ reprehendentis eum,cap.19,ver.2.
Amplificetur ex thesi de fœderibus cum impiis per occupationem: Etsi quædam aliquando sint licita & necessaria de finibus, commerciis, pace: tamen alia verbo Dei damnari,
Ratio II. à causa impulsiva: partim externa: amicitia regis potentis sed impii: partim interna: diffidentia auxilii divini.
Ratio III. Quia scandalum dedit subditis, quasi foris non improbaret Idololatriam, quam domi abrogaverat.
Amplificetur à circumstantiis: Michæ oraculo non obtemperat: connivet ad colaphos & carcerem Michæ in gratiam Achabi.

page.notes: The marginal sign before "Amplificetur" (a printed hand-like mark) is not reproduced. The Greek word after "habeat" reads γνώμῳ, with some doubt about the accent. The printed "Ratio 1 1." and "Ratio 1 1 1." are read as II. and III. The sign before "Achabo" in the subtitle is a printed mark, not a letter, and is omitted. The first line of the page may continue an earlier paragraph; the scan does not show this clearly. Right edge: show-through from the facing page, not transcribed.
